about_the_game:
SPEEDRUNNING //

Master your aim, strafing, and routing to complete maps as quickly as possible!

LEADERBOARDS //

Compete against yourself and against players all across the world in our global leaderboards!

WEAPONS //

Use a diverse arsenal of your favourite weapons, with a responsive system built for skilled players.

MOVEMENT //

Players of the Source Engine games will be familiar with your strafe-heavy movement system, designed for a high skill ceiling, further enhancing difficulty and complexity.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains different types of weapons.

short_description: Compete with players around the world in a fast-paced 3D platforming shooter. Race through a variety of hand crafted maps, shooting at targets with an arsenal of weapons, all to achieve the fastest time on the global leaderboard!
